Definition: from G1586; (divine) selection (abstractly or concretely):--chosen, election.
BiblicalUsage: Election is God's selection, His choosing of a people for Himself, and Paul uses it for Israel and for the church. He says the purpose of God according to election stands, not of works but of Him who calls, and that at this present time there is a remnant according to the election of grace. The Lord tells Ananias that Paul is a chosen vessel to bear His name before Gentiles and kings, and the word holds both the choosing and the sending.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe election means God has a purpose that no failure of mine can undo, because His choosing stands on His call, not on my works. My position is that grace chose me, and grace will finish what it started.
